ui_87bfadafaea3b248: Ingcikitsi yelucwaningo leyashiwo mhla tinge-8 Imphala 2026. Titfombe letingenhla tivuselelwe ngekwehlukana.
ui_d41d826aa43ae0f5: Emathuba lasuselwa ku-CME achaza intsengo yelikusasa, hhayi setsembiso se-Fed. Emalebuli ekubamba/kwenyuka/kusika asebentisa libanga lelihlosiwe lelisemtsetfweni lekugcina lelitfolakalako. Catsanisa umhlangano lofanako kanye nebanga le-target-rate ngesikhatsi lesifanako. Beansprout kanye ne Investing bangahlanganyela tintfo letifakwako telikusasa letisisekelo, ngako-ke akusito emavoti latimele. Lushintjo ekusakateni lungakhombisa idatha lensha, intsengo yenkontileka noma kucabanga; kulinganisa titfombe letingahambisani kwengeta kuciniseka lokungemanga.
ui_bfb5056f4090648b: Ematharifi: lizinga lentsengo uma kucatsaniswa nekwenyuka kwemazinga entsengo
ui_4261cc1e72bdcb33: Ematharifi akhuphula tindleko tekungenisa, kepha emanani ebatsengi ancike kumamargin, tintfo letikhona, kufaka esikhundleni semphakeli kanye nekufuna. Lucwaningo lweNew York Fed lwamhla tinge-6 Imphala luchaza kudlula kancane kancane. Lizinga lentsengo leliphakeme alidzingi kusho kukhula kwemazinga emali lokuhlala njalo: kukhula kwemazinga emali ngemnyaka kungaba lula uma ngabe kukhula kwekucala kwehla ekucatsaniselweni. Tingucuko letiphindzaphindvwako tematharifi noma imiphumela lephikelelako yemholo kanye nekulindzela kungakhulisa umfutfo.
ui_825a86cc728d9569: Luhlolo lwaseNew York Fed lwaJulayi lutfole kutsi lamanye emafemu esifundza asahlela kunyuka kwemanani ngemuva kwekukhokha ematharifi. Loku kubufakazi bekutsi kungenteka kutsi kube nephayiphi, hhayi kubiketela kwekwenyuka kwemali kwavelonkhe noma kubukwa lokusha kweMphala. Tilinganiso teSisekelo Semtselo tichaza imiphumela yenchubomgomo lemodeliwe, ayibikwa CPI. Hlola emanani lafezekile, kwehla kwemazinga emali etinsita kanye nekulindzelwa kwekwenyuka kwemazinga emali ngaphambi kwekutsi kuphatfwe sihloko semali lekhokhelwako njengebufakazi besincumo selizinga lelitsite.
ui_422afc9773ac3b29: Umgogodla lonamatselako PCE, kunyuka kwemanani ngalokubanti kanye nekulindzela lokukhulako bekutawucinisa licala lekuvimbela. Kucasha lokutsambile, kungasebenti lokusetulu kanye nekufuna lokubutsakatsaka kutawukhulisa tindleko tekucinisa. Kubamba kungavumela bufakazi lobunyenti kutsi bufike ngaphandle kwekukhipha kuhamba kamuva. Fundza sitatimende, vota, kucagela uma kuhlelelwe, kanye nenkomfa yetindzaba ndzawonye. CNBC kanye naletinye tihloko letikhona nyalo te-Fed letingezansi tingeta umongo wekubika; kuphawula akusiyo lenye imodeli yematfuba.
